arxiv-2103-02325.title: On the Effectiveness of Adversarial Training Against Common Corruptions
arxiv-2103-02325.creator: Klim KireevEPFL, Maksym AndriushchenkoEPFLNicolas FlammarionEPFL
arxiv-2103-02325.description: Abstract The literature on robustness towards common corruptions shows no consensus on whether adversarial training can improve the performance in this setting. First, we show that, when used with an appropriately selected perturbation radius, ℓ p \l_{p} adversarial training can serve as a strong baseline against common corruptions improving both accuracy and calibration.

arxiv-2103-10410.title: MILP for the Multi-objective VM Reassignment Problem
arxiv-2103-10410.creator: Takfarinas Saber 1 , Anthony Ventresque 1 2 , Joao Marques-Silva 3 , James Thorburn 4 , Liam Murphy 1
arxiv-2103-10410.description: Abstract Machine Reassignment is a challenging problem for constraint programming (CP) and mixed integer linear programming (MILP) approaches, especially given the size of data centres. The multi-objective version of the Machine Reassignment Problem is even more challenging and it seems unlikely for CP or MILP to obtain good results in this context.

arxiv-2103-11318.title: Language-Agnostic Representation Learning of Source Code from Structure and Context
arxiv-2103-11318.creator: Daniel Zügner, Tobias Kirschstein, Michele Catasta, Jure Leskovec, Stephan Günnemann
arxiv-2103-11318.description: Abstract Source code ( Context ) and its parsed abstract syntax tree (AST; Structure ) are two complementary representations of the same computer program. Traditionally, designers of machine learning models have relied predominantly either on Structure or Context. We propose a new model, which jointly learns on Context and Structure of source code.

arxiv-2105-05740.title: Iterative process of order 2 2 without inverting the derivative
arxiv-2105-05740.creator: Tamara Kogan \;\;, Ariel Sapir \;\;, Luba Sapir \;\;, Eytan Sapir \;\;, Amir Sapir
arxiv-2105-05740.description: Abstract We prove the sufficient conditions for convergence of a certain iterative process of order 2 2 for solving nonlinear functional equations, which does not require inverting the derivative. We translate and detail our results for a system of nonlinear equations, and apply it for some numerical example which illustrates our theorems.

arxiv-2109-06543.title: Foreground Object Structure Transfer for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation Publication type: Article Type
arxiv-2109-06543.creator: Jieren Cheng, Le Liu, Xiangyan Tang, Wenxuan Tu, Boyi Liu, Ke Zhou, Qiaobo Da, Yue Yang
arxiv-2109-06543.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jieren Cheng, Le Liu, Xiangyan Tang, Wenxuan Tu, Boyi Liu, Ke Zhou, Qiaobo Da, Yue Yang. Unsupervised domain adaptation aims to train a classification model from the labeled source domain for the unlabeled target domain. Since the data distributions of the two domains are different, the model often performs poorly on the target domain. Existing methods align the feature distributions of the source and target domains and learn domain-invariant features to improve the performance of the model.

arxiv-2401-07927.title: Are self-explanations from Large Language Models faithful?
arxiv-2401-07927.creator: Andreas Madsen, Sarath Chandar, Siva Reddy
arxiv-2401-07927.description: Abstract Instruction-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at many tasks and will even explain their reasoning, so-called self-explanations. However, convincing and wrong self-explanations can lead to unsupported confidence in LLMs, thus increasing risk. Therefore, it’s important to measure if self-explanations truly reflect the model’s behavior.

arxiv-2401-12833.title: Equivariant K K -theory of even-dimensional complex quadrics
arxiv-2401-12833.creator: Bidhan Paul
arxiv-2401-12833.description: Abstract . The aim of this paper is to describe the torus equivariant K K -ring of even-dimensional complex quadrics by studying the graph equivariant K K -theory of their corresponding GKM graphs. This involves providing a presentation for its graph equivariant K K - ring in terms of generators and relations.

arxiv-2406-19923.title: Water Evolution & Inventories of Super-Earths Orbiting Late M Dwarfs
arxiv-2406-19923.creator: Keavin Moore, Benjamin David, Albert Yian Zhang, Nicolas B. Cowan
arxiv-2406-19923.description: Abstract Super-Earths orbiting M-dwarf stars may be the most common habitable planets in the Universe. However, their habitability is threatened by intense irradiation from their host stars, which drives the escape of water to space and can lead to surface desiccation.

arxiv-2409-17294.title: Schrödinger bridge based deep conditional generative learning
arxiv-2409-17294.creator: Hanwen Huang
arxiv-2409-17294.description: Abstract Conditional generative models represent a significant advancement in the field of machine learning, allowing for the controlled synthesis of data by incorporating additional information into the generation process. In this work we introduce a novel Schrödinger bridge based deep generative method for learning conditional distributions.

arxiv-2505-09894.title: Advancing Mobile UI Testing by Learning Screen Usage Semantics
arxiv-2505-09894.creator: Safwat Ali Khan, skhan89@gmu.edu
arxiv-2505-09894.description: Abstract The demand for quality in mobile applications has increased greatly given users’ high reliance on them for daily tasks. Developers work tirelessly to ensure that their applications are both functional and user-friendly. In pursuit of this, Automated Input Generation (AIG) tools have emerged as a promising solution for testing mobile applications by simulating user interactions and exploring app functionalities.

arxiv-2509-24536.title: Effective β \beta -decay rates of r r -process waiting points in realistic stellar environments
arxiv-2509-24536.creator: Qi-Ye Hu, Long-Jun Wang, Yang Sun
arxiv-2509-24536.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Qi-Ye Hu, Long-Jun Wang, Yang Sun. Reliable nuclear weak rates are key inputs for understanding the origin of heavy elements and constraining the environments of the corresponding stellar nucleosynthesis. We present the effective stellar β − \beta^{-} -decay rates of the N = 50 , 82 , 126 N=50,82,126 r r -process waiting-point nuclei in realistic stellar environments with high temperature, high density and strong magnetic field.

arxiv-2511-16141.title: Phonon Dichroisms Revealing Unusual Electronic Quantum Geometry
arxiv-2511-16141.creator: Ding Li, Guoao Yang, Tao Qin, Jianhui Zhou, Yugui Yao
arxiv-2511-16141.description: Abstract The quantum geometry tensor, intrinsic geometric characteristics of electronic states, plays a crucial role in the various nontrivial electromagnetic phenomena in quantum materials. Here, we reveal that quantum geometry significantly modifies phonon dichroisms through electron-phonon interactions in solids that break time-reversal and spatial inversion symmetries.

arxiv-2602-17725.title: Scaling Laws for Template-Free Detection of Environmental Phase Modulation in Gravitational-Wave Signals Publication type: Paper
arxiv-2602-17725.creator: Jericho Cain 1,∗ \orcid 0000-0003-4731-9142
arxiv-2602-17725.description: Abstract Environmental effects such as hierarchical triple motion introduce cumulative phase modulation in gravitational-wave signals through time-dependent line-of-sight acceleration. Whether such effects are observable depends on both deformation strength and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). However, this relationship has not been quantified in a waveform-agnostic manner. Here we investigate the detectability of smooth time-warp distortions using template-free time–frequency representations.

pmc-10740900.title: Predicting the Potential Distribution of the Szechwan Rat Snake (Euprepiophis perlacea) and Its Response to Climate Change in the Yingjing Area of the Giant Panda National Park
pmc-10740900.creator: Xinqiang Song, Ying Jiang, Li Zhao, Long Jin, Chengzhi Yan, Wenbo Liao, Chunwang Li
pmc-10740900.description: Simple SummaryThis study employs maxent models to investigate the impact of climate change on the potential distribution of the Szechwan rat snake (Euprepiophis perlacea) in the Yingjing Area of the Giant Panda National Park. The analysis reveals the significant effects of distance from the streams and slope of the geographic distribution of E. perlacea.

pmc-12524421.title: Post-Traumatic Stress, Workplace Violence, Resilience, and Burnout: A Path Analysis Among Korean Paramedics
pmc-12524421.creator: Jieun Sung, Nayoon Lee, Alicja Bortkiewicz, Małgorzata Kurpesa
pmc-12524421.description: Background/Objectives: Paramedics frequently encounter potentially traumatic events and workplace violence, increasing their risk of burnout. Resilience may attenuate these effects. We examined the pathways through which post-traumatic stress (PTS) and workplace violence influence burnout and clarified the role of resilience among Korean paramedics.

pmc-12586959.title: Reformation of science publishing: the Stockholm Declaration
pmc-12586959.creator: Bernhard Sabel, Dan Larhammar
pmc-12586959.description: Science relies on integrity and trustworthiness. But scientists under career pressure are lured to purchase fake publications from ‘paper mills’ that use AI-generated data, text and image fabrication. The number of low-quality or fraudulent publications is rising to hundreds of thousands per year, which—if unchecked—will damage the scientific and economic progress of our societies.

pmc-12595689.title: Prevention of alcohol use and promotion of well-being among middle school students: a study protocol for a randomized controlled trial of ADAPT
pmc-12595689.creator: Kristine Rømer Thomsen, Natascha Hareskov, Camilla Krogner Caspersen, Anne Maria Lauenborg, Mette Gammelmark Bergmann, Eva Ørnbøl, Kaare Bro Wellnitz, Sarah W Feldstein Ewing
pmc-12595689.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundAlcohol use during adolescence has both immediate as well as long-term negative effects; in turn, delaying onset and preventing hazardous use in early adolescence is one essential avenue to protect and bolster adolescents’ socioemotional growth and neurodevelopment. This trial examines the effectiveness, feasibility and acceptability of a novel neurodevelopmentally informed intervention – Adolescent Developmentally-Appropriate health Promotion Therapy (ADAPT) among students in middle school.

pmc-12623128.title: Intrathoracic Vagal Schwannoma Mimicking Metastatic Lymphadenopathy with a Positional Shift
pmc-12623128.creator: Rina Takahashi, Tomonari Oki, Shuhei Iizuka, Yoshiro Otsuki, Toru Nakamura
pmc-12623128.description: INTRODUCTIONSchwannomas are benign tumors originating from peripheral nerve sheaths and are most commonly found in the head, neck, and extremities. Intrathoracic schwannomas, particularly those arising from the vagus nerve, are relatively rare. Despite their benign nature, schwannomas often exhibit fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) uptake on PET scans, potentially leading to diagnostic confusion.

pmc-12794525.title: Evolution of the Global Landscape of Nanoparticles and Nanotubes in Advancing Oncological Care: A Bibliometric Analysis
pmc-12794525.creator: Tori M Baer, Rishank Chillakuru, Latha Ganti
pmc-12794525.description: This study aims to analyze the literature published regarding nano-oncology and, more specifically, global trends concerning nanoparticles and nanotubes from 2003 to 2025. This bibliometric analysis gathered data from the Web of Science Core Collection, incorporating keywords such as oncology, nanotechnology, nanomedicine, nanoparticles, and nanotubes.

pmc-13178421.title: Commercial artificial intelligence–assisted performance and interpretation time of first-on-call radiology residents using computed tomography pulmonary angiography to detect pulmonary embolism: a multireader, multicenter study
pmc-13178421.creator: Xinyu Song, Shuhao Wang, Jiaoyan Wang, Hongmin Shu, Ruipeng Zhang, Bicong Yan, Yang Qu, Yangtong Li, Linghuan Guo, Yanbo Chen, Dan Wang, Yuehua Li
pmc-13178421.description: BackgroundAcute pulmonary embolism (PE) is characterized by sudden onset, high mortality, and a propensity for misdiagnosis. Although artificial intelligence (AI)-based software for PE detection has been shown to accurately identify thrombi on computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA), its impact on the performance of first-on-call radiologists of varying experience levels during initial interpretation remains unclear.

pmc-13254884.title: BRPtools: An AutoML-Powered web platform for multiclass disease prediction from bulk blood RNA-seq data
pmc-13254884.creator: Yichen Guo, Fengyuan Yang, Xuelu Zhang, Zhaoyu Zhai, Jianbo Pan
pmc-13254884.description: Blood-based transcriptomic profiling provides a minimally invasive approach for disease diagnosis; however, the integration of large-scale, heterogeneous RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) datasets remains challenging. Here, we manually curated and uniformly reprocessed 134 publicly available human RNA-seq datasets (n = 9,872 samples), covering 88 distinct blood-related diseases from whole blood and peripheral blood mononuclear cell data.

pmc-13277388.creator: Ayalew Temesgen Wodajo, Birhan Amanie Mekonnen, Shewaye Lakew Mekuria, Gizachew Mulugeta Manahelohe, Priya Gusain

pmc-13396669.title: Pervasive convergent evolution of sperm conjugation across the Arthropoda tree of life
pmc-13396669.creator: R. Antonio Gomez, Romano Dallai, David Mercati, Rita Sinka, Steve Dorus, Scott Pitnick
pmc-13396669.description: Theory suggests that ejaculates should evolve heightened functionality through integration of their component parts: spermatozoa, seminal fluid, and ejaculate structures. Here, we exhaustively review the vast literature on sperm ultrastructure in arthropods to examine sperm conjugation - a form of social cooperation among sperm - and its relationship with an ostensible antecedent: membrane-bound, extracellular sperm-associated material (SAM).

pmc-13476437.title: Fuzzy topological analysis of fuzzy Helm graphs with applications to protein interaction networks
pmc-13476437.creator: Zeeshan Saleem Mufti, Ali H. Tedjani, Shama Liaqat, Gamachu Adugna Ganati
pmc-13476437.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In biological and chemical networks, in which the strength of interactions is often not absolute, uncertainty is an inherent feature of many real-world networks. A fuzzy graph consists of vertices with fuzzy memberships and fuzzy relationships among vertices and edges; therefore, fuzzy graph theory is a natural approach for modelling systems in which the connections between the vertices are fuzzy or not precisely known.

pmc-13679368.title: The chromosome-level genome of Mesobuthus martensii provides insights into its evolution and the diversity of venom peptides
pmc-13679368.creator: Daixi Liu, Qianhui Zeng, Yifei Sun, Changfen Li, Yanjun Song, Zhuo Shang, Kunlong Li, Hongjie Zhu, Feng Li, Chuanbin Shen, Jianhua Ju
pmc-13679368.description: Mesobuthus martensii, the source species of the traditional Chinese medicine “Quanxie”, has long been utilized for its therapeutic properties. Venom peptides are recognized as the major active molecular basis of these pharmacological activities. Despite this, their development as therapeutic agents remains poorly explored.

uslaw-usc-t16-s760e.title: 16 U.S.C. § 760e — Study of migratory game fish; waters; research; purpose
uslaw-usc-t16-s760e.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s760e.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 9A (Preservation Of Fishery Resources). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of Commerce is directed to undertake a comprehensive continuing study of the migratory marine fish of interest to recreational fishermen of the United States, including species inhabiting the offshore waters of the United States and species which migrate through or spend a part.
